text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Arima Kinen where everyone gave it 
their all, where everyone threw everything 
on the line, has just come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing atop that peak was a solitary 
Umamusume, born from no one's shadow—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder, reporting back in... 1st 
place...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Hehe, are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Trainer, really. Don't go getting too 
satisfied just yet, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if this is the pinnacle, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I... ngh, fully intend to keep climbing 
higher and higher with you...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Grass... chan...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan......

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I... I wanted... to w-win... Ugh, 
guhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ah... uuuuugh...! Aaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you for giving it everything you 
had against me, Spe-chan.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because we shared today together, I can 
keep moving forward once more.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... let's race each other again at the 
end of our respective paths, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, yeah. Yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I was going to say, 'I'll be waiting 
for you in the Dream Trophy,' but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I'm hopeless... I can't wait until those 
girls get here...!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I'll run in next year's Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because—I've been longing for this 
forever. It's what I've always dreamed of.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My exceptionally cute—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My... our path still stretches on without 
end.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I am still too clumsy and weak to be 
called the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But—today. Today, of all days.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Today, I think I'll... give myself a 
little praise, too.
choice_data_list: I'll shower you with praise too!
I'll give you plenty of praise too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Nnh... It's a little embarrassing, though.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Please give it your all just for today♪
